component.name: HiTuxShare
component.summary: Chat and share files on the BeShare network

description.p: HiTuxShare is a native Linux client for the BeShare file-sharing network, speaking the MUSCLE protocol. It joins the same chat rooms, user lists and file searches as the Haiku and BeOS clients it was ported from.

File searches are live subscriptions rather than snapshots: results keep arriving as other people share things, with nothing to refresh. Transfers go directly between peers and never through the server.
It is a port of HiShare for Haiku, itself the modern edition of Jeremy Friesner's BeShare.
First working version: chat, live file search, downloads and sharing.
